newsitem.title: UK: UK plans swift privatisation of ADAS.
newsitem.headline: UK plans swift privatisation of ADAS.

text.p: The government is to proceed with the privatisation of the research and development functions of its Agricultural Development and Advisory Service "as quickly as possible", Agriculture Minister Douglas Hogg said on Monday.
He said in a written parliamentary answer that the government would invite expressions of interest for the business as a whole or any of its constituent parts.
ADAS research and development is carried out at 10 experimental centres in England and Wales with back up laboratories at Wolverhampton, central England.
In 1994-5 these employed some 730 staff, including 512 scientists, and their total income was 23.6 million stg.
Hogg said he would prefer to sell the business as a whole.
